department: Hermann Staudinger Graduate School (Faculty of Chemistry and Pharmacy)

deadline.value: No fixed deadline is given. Apply at the earliest possible date; for foreign degrees the signed paper form must reach the PhD Office four weeks before the next committee meeting.
deadline.quote: must apply for acceptance as a doctoral candidate at the earliest possible date

also.quote: If foreign degrees are submitted, the printed and signed application must be available in the PhD office at least four weeks before the next meeting of the Doctoral Examination Committee.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test is mentioned on the HSGS application page.

supervisor.value: A doctoral supervision agreement with the Faculty of Chemistry and Pharmacy must be attached to the application before acceptance.
supervisor.quote: Doctoral supervision agreement of the Faculty of Chemistry and Pharmacy (§ 4 (2) of PO 2016)

funding.value: The HSGS acceptance page states no funding rule.

entry_route.value: Applicants upload proof of a degree that qualifies them for doctoral study, for example a Master of Science certificate.
entry_route.quote: Proof of a degree qualifying for doctoral studies in the scientific subject, e.g. Master of Science certificate.

notes: Foreign degrees must be recognised by the Doctoral Examination Committee (§ 5 (2) PO 2016). The HSGS page says the PO 2016 is the only binding document. The university-wide English rule is inherited (no programme-specific English test found).
